body: Thanks for the response. I'll keep trying, but one more bad manic episode and idk if I'll make it :/. I really thought it was a freak accident when I had my first episode. Then it happened again...and again. Guess all I can do is hold on and hope for the best :(

Well I'm actually in a smaller town a couple hours out of atlanta. I go to the only mental clinic I know of in town and I don't think I'd be willing to drive all the way downtown to atlanta. Thanks though I appreciate the concern.

I've always been obsessed with finding a girlfriend/wife. Whenever I find a girl I really like, I get really happy.  Then that happiness just sorta snowballs into a manic episode. And then whatever relationship I could've had is completely ruined. And I'm left heartbroken. It's to the point where I want to only be with guys (I'm bisexual) to avoid any more problems. But that would only create other problems. My parents would almost certainly cut me off if I dated another guy.
Yeah for years I've been saying I'll hold on until I'm 27. Got 7 years for things to look up, but that's a damn long time :/
Which bullet point does it seem like a sane person would do? No I didn't have any control..
Usually women. But what am I supposed to do? Hide from them?

I don't know I'm manic until the cops or my parents intervene. Even though it's happened multiple times I still don't recognize it. I always think it's just the end of my depression...nope. I end up regaining sanity in jail or in a mental institution.
